messages:
Priya: FYI we're locking in a vendor pentest for 2024-12-08. Need clear roles for S3 ingest, KMS handling, RBAC mapping, and a retest gate. Who's around to take ops ownership?
Mark: I can take ops. Goals: minimal privileges for assessors, automated wrapping, and tamper-evident audit. Quick proposal incoming.
Elena: For KMS, prefer granting CreateGrant + Encrypt only for the ingest workflow. Decrypt should be split to a separate recovery role requiring 2-person approval. Use CreateGrant with Constraints for EncryptionContext to bind to artefact id.
Tom: Sounds good. We also need to ensure CloudTrail logs show kms:GenerateDataKey/Encrypt and S3 PutObject events. Retention 120 days for this engagement.
Priya: Ops, please avoid giving assessors any KMS permissions. They get presigned PUT URLs only. After upload, ops runs an automated wrap that calls `kms:Encrypt` with an EncryptionContext that includes `pt_id` and `assessor_id`.
Mark: Implementation sketch:
1) ops creates GUID artifact id
2) onboard-bot returns presigned PUT limited to prefix `/pt-ingest/<guid>/` with headers required: x-pt-upload:true and content-length-range 1-100MB
3) assessor uploads artifact.tar.gz + manifest.json (sha256 checksums)
4) ops lambda validates headers and manifest, then calls KMS Encrypt, stores artifact as encrypted at `evidence/pt-<guid>/artifact.tar.gz.enc`
5) ops records CloudTrail event IDs in evidence metadata and pins to Jira ticket
Elena: Good. Example grant flow in pseudo: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/pt-ops --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextEquals={"pt_id":"<guid>"}`. Then revoke grant after wrap.
Priya: RBAC matrix idea: assessor (pt-assessors), ingest-ops (pt-ops), triage-view (sec-triage-read), remediation (eng-remediate). Add a short-lived role `pt-assessor-jump` that maps to the Okta group for live sessions.
Tom: Make sure triage-view doesn't have s3:GetObject for encrypted artifacts. They should only see metadata and Jira links until recovery procedure is approved.
Mark: We'll add object metadata tags: `pt:guid`, `pt:encrypted:true`, and store CloudTrail IDs in object metadata and Jira. Also require manifest signed by assessor GPG fingerprint if available.
Priya: Retest gate: cannot schedule retest until: evidence archived, CloudTrail logs attached, manifest checksum validated, and remediation PRs linked. Add a checklist in Jira PT-DEC24-GATE.
Elena: About presigned PUT security: add short TTL (30m), enforce content-type checks and max size via a presign policy and S3 bucket policy condition for `x-pt-upload:true`. Also validate file magic bytes in lambda before wrapping.
Tom: IR escalation: if assessor finds live compromise, tag message with `!incident` and post to #incidents plus page on-call via PagerDuty. Include `incident:pt-external` in payload.
Priya: Can someone draft the minimal runbook (ops steps + commands) I can share with vendor? Keep it scriptable.
Mark: I'll draft now. Key commands: presign s3, validate manifest, kms encrypt, record CloudTrail event IDs. Will paste before EOD.
onboard-bot: Reminder: please fill the PT intake form: https://redwood.atlassian.net/pt-intake (submitted by Priya)
Priya: Thanks. Follow-up: Mark, paste Okta group IDs when you provision roles so infra can automate grant creation. Also set SSO session timeouts for pt-assessor-jump to 2h.
Mark: Will do. I'll post links to the runbook, calendar slot, and Jira epic in this thread when ready.
Tom: Also adding acceptance criteria to block production rollouts for any `pt-blocker` labeled fixes until retest sign-off.
Priya: Great work team. Small note: keep audit retention longer if the vendor requests more time for analysis. We'll handle extensions case-by-case.
Mark: Locking timeline + roles. Runbook link incoming. :white_check_mark:
